author: jdaniel95x
quote: Let's just list the problems it's 30 fps (or less), $100 digital only.  You have the usual libral propaganda we have for the past 10 years or more. The game just has you playing as a simp loser the whole time doing chores for Lucia. Also, Lucia is an annoying dumbass of a character.  ps5 pro doesn't even 30 fps most of the time dropping to under 25 fps during action parts. This is only the tip of the iceberg of issues this game has. The 99 critic scores saying this game is a masterpiece are payed for.
